failure_summary.description: agent body does not document how the OmicOS runtime should rank this agent vs sibling pathology agents (he_to_st_predictor, spatial_omics_orchestrator) when use_when intents partially overlap

edits.content:
## Routing priority vs siblings

When the OmicOS runtime has multiple matching agents:

- THIS agent ranks **highest** when input is H&E pixels + user wants
  morphology / cell / classification / survival / RNALinker association /
  virtual staining.
- `he_to_st_predictor` ranks higher than this agent for explicit
  "predict gene expression from H&E" intents — the runtime should
  prefer it even if this agent also matches.
- `spatial_omics_orchestrator` ranks higher for "downstream spatial-omics
  on existing AnnData" intents.
- `scientific_writer` takes over once a report is produced.

For ambiguous intents (user has BOTH H&E and intent for molecular
prediction), both agents may run sequentially — this agent first as
upstream WSI prep, then `he_to_st_predictor` as the molecular layer.
